title: Was a good vacuum until it wasn't.
text: Was a good vacuum until it wasn't.. The vacuum is a little noisy, but did a good job of sucking things up. I then heard a message of the main brush not working. I took the vacuum apart and tried to remove the dirt on the main brush but it still has not functioned the same since.

product_metadata.title: Tikom Robot Vacuum Cleaner, 2700Pa Robotic Vacuums with Self-Charging, Good for Pet Hair, Carpets, Hard Floors, Black
features: GYROSCOPE SMART NAVIGATION: G7000 Robotic Vacuums will clean your home more thoroughly following an efficient Zig-zag path, when compared to random path robotic vacuums. This exclusive smart navigation improves cleaning efficiency by 30%.

2700PA SUCTION & SELF-CHARGING: 2700pa strong suction can deal with dust and hair with ease and delivers a perfect cleaning performance to medium-pile carpet and hardwood floor. it auto will return to Charging Station once Battery is Low.
SMART APP & VOICE CONTROL:G7000 Robotic Vacuums can works with App, including 5 cleaning modes: smart clean&edge clean&spot clean&random clean&manual clean, also can connect to Alexa and Google Home.
CARPET BOOST & BOUNDARY STRIPS:G7000 Robot Vacuum Cleaner can automatically increase 3X suction power on carpet to provide deeper cleaning. Boundary Strips can help you set None-go areas.

FREE RETURN: packages include robotic vacuum, 6.6ft Boundary Strips, Remote Control, Charging Station, AC Power Adapter, 4 Side Brushes, Cleaning Brush, HEPA(with sponge), 5 Cable Ties, Adhesive Tapes, User Manual, Quick Start Guide, and our Worry-free 12-month Warranty.
